title: Fix Coda Desktop Dev Startup
description: Coda desktop fails to start with 'ENOSPC: System limit for number of file watchers reached'. The Cursor Nx Language Server (nrwl.angular-console) was consuming 935k out of 1M inotify watches. Fixed by killing the process to free watches, then retrying the dev server.
summary: Fixed 3 issues blocking coda desktop dev startup: (1) inotify watch limit exhausted by Cursor Nx LS (PID 17865 using 935k/1M watches) — killed process to free watches; (2) vite.main.config.ts was empty causing main.js to be built without CJS format, then rejected by Node due to package.json "type":"module" — added CJS lib build config and removed "type":"module"; (3) globals.css used @variant dark which is not valid in Tailwind v4 — replaced with @custom-variant declaration and .dark CSS rule; (4) vite.renderer.config.ts used import.meta.url incompatible with CJS package — replaced with __dirname directly. App now starts and runs, only ECONNREFUSED on port 8080 (expected, coda MCP backend not running).
